key_insight: LLM-generated quantum circuits need layered gatekeeping because many failures are structural, not just incorrect answers.
engineering_relevance: For quantum software pipelines, the study shows evaluation infrastructure must validate physics, APIs, and runtime behavior before circuits reach expensive simulation or experiment stages.
method: Circuit fidelity checks against H2/STO-3G/Jordan-Wigner/UCCSD references
Design entropy to measure run-to-run consistency
evidence_signal: Across multiple foundation models in a Materials Project pipeline, the authors identified five distinct failure modes and found that two apparent model errors were actually caused by silent fallback logic in the evaluation harness.
watch_item: Results depend on the reliability of the testing harness, so hidden template substitution or other infrastructure bugs can contaminate model assessment.
paper_title: Gatekeepers and Hallucinations: A Layered Evaluation Framework for LLM-Driven Quantum Circuit Generation
